notes.title: Update Early Access V2.1.0 - 31.01.2025
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone! Update V2.1.0 Early Access is now LIVE![/b]

We’re rolling out another update with gameplay improvements, visual changes, and bug fixes. Here’s what’s new:

[h2]Map Changes:[/h2]
• Ravenwood Manor is now set as the first map, and Crimsonwood House is now the second.

[h2]Emote System Rework:[/h2]
• The Emote Wheel has been removed—you can now play emotes using F1 to F8.
• You can now see your character in third person while emoting.

[h2]Gameplay Adjustments:[/h2]
• Flashlight brightness adjusted.
• Added a bright flare effect to the player's flashlight.
• Tasks are no longer visible by pressing [TAB]. Instead, you’ll find them on a notepad located on the cleaning cart outside.
• Info board inside the lobby has been updated.
• Loading screen tips have been changed.
• Ghosts now spawn based on a timer and on your progress in the mission
• Inventory is now always visible.
• Collected trash now appears as a UI icon until it is thrown away.

[h2]Visual Improvements to:[/h2]
[h3]Player’s View:[/h3]
• Adjusted the color palette for a fresh visual experience.
• Field of View (FOV) adjusted for better perspective.
• Vignette effect updated for a more immersive feel.
[h3]Ravenwood & Crimsonwood:[/h3]
• Added dust effects for better atmosphere.
• Changed all indoor and outdoor lights.
• Added light flares for a more cinematic experience.
• Adjusted fog density.
• Lit candles now emit light, but ghosts can still walk through them (for now).

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
• Fixed a bug where the ghost spawn sound would play twice.
• Fixed a bug where the mop appeared too large compared to the player’s character.

notes.title: Update Early Access V2.0.4 - 27.12.2024

notes.title: Major Update Early Access V2.0.0 - 20.12.2024
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hi everyone! Christmas Update V2.0.0 is Here![/b][/h2]

Celebrate the holidays with our special Christmas event, packed with festive surprises, new features, and bug fixes! 

[h2][b]Here's what's included:[/b][/h2]
• The lobby has been reworked with holiday decor!
• 2 new event-exclusive hats have been added—grab them before they're gone!
• The main menu now embraces the Christmas spirit!

[h2][b]New Ghost: The Nun[/b][/h2]
• The Nun only reveals herself when nearby.
• She moves slowly but charges quickly when you're in her range.
• She floats, leaving no footsteps, and flickers lights to trick you into thinking she’s near.

[h2][b]Emote Wheel Added![/b][/h2]
• Express yourself with dance and interaction emotes!
• Use the "`" key to access the emote wheel.

[h2][b]Spectator Mode Reworked![/b][/h2]
• A new 3rd-person camera has been added for a fresh perspective while spectating.

[h3][b]Other Changes:[/b][/h3]
• Footprints are now slightly purple for better visibility.
• Nightmare mode rewards increased from 2x -> 3x.
• Camera look-up angle increased from 20 -> 40 degrees.
• Updated tips in loading screens.
• Info board in the lobby has been refreshed.
• Ghost movement reworked for smoother gameplay.

[h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3]
• Fixed a bug preventing the pink room door in City Lights Villa from opening from inside.
• Resolved an issue where ghosts could leave houses on Easy difficulty.
• Fixed ghosts getting stuck on lanterns outside City Lights Villa.
• Corrected missing collider on the lobby barrel.

[h3][b]Known issues:[/b][/h3]
• The new spectator camera might be a bit jittery. We will launch a hotfix when we repair it. 

[h3][b]Event Duration:[/b][/h3]
The Christmas Update will be live for 2 weeks only!

[h3][b]Report Bugs & Share Feedback:[/b][/h3]
We’ve tested this update thoroughly, but if you find any bugs or issues, please report them on our Discord Server so we can address them.

[b]Thank you all for your continued support, feedback, and enthusiasm! We hope you enjoy this festive update. Merry Christmas and Happy New Year to all of you![/b]

notes.title: Update Early Access V1.1.7 - 29.11.2024

We've got new content for you and some tweaks in this update. Check out the details below:

• Another task has been added, bringing the total to 4 tasks per map!

notes.title: Update Early Access V1.1.5 - 24.10.2024
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! [b]Update V1.1.5 Early Access is now LIVE![/b]

We've got some exciting new content for you in this update. Check out the details below:

notes.title: Halloween Update - Update Early Access V1.1.4 - 18.10.2024
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone! V1.1.4 Early Access - Halloween Update is Live! [/b]
Get ready to embrace the spooky season with a whole new set of features and tasks across all maps! Here's what’s in store for you:

[b]Halloween Spirit on All Maps:[/b]
• We've added one extra task to every map, tied to the Halloween theme. Complete it for extra cash! 
• We've also updated the main menu and the lobby and inside the lobby, an easter egg awaits you 

[b]Gameplay Updates:[/b]
• [b]Jumpscares have been reworked and doubled across all maps[/b] for even more terrifying moments!
• [b]The generator will now have a random location every game[/b], keeping you on your toes.
• Every map will now have an easy and a hard task.
• We've added the Laboratory Achievement for playing the newly released Laboratory map.

[b]Changes:[/b]
• Added a VHS mode toggle in the options menu for that classic horror feel.
• You can now control General, Music, and Voice Chat volume independently in the options.
• Mannequin's color has been changed.
• The post-game screen now provides more detailed information about your mission and performance.
• Added a Discord button inside the main menu.

[b]Quality of Life Improvements:[/b]
• Jumpscare chances have been increased for even more thrilling encounters.
• You no longer need a broom to collect paper; just grab it and go!
• Players no longer collide with grab-able objects.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
• Fixed a bug where jumpscares on the Laboratory map could crash the game.
• Fixed an issue where dying with a cleaned item in hand in Laboratory wouldn't respawn the item.
• Fixed an issue where returning to the lobby with an item in hand from the Laboratory map would cause you to still hold the item.
• Resolved an issue where the player shop was visible after starting the game.
• Fixed a bug where customizing your character caused you to disappear if another player joined the lobby.
• Fixed a piece of paper that was stuck inside the wall on Ravenwood Manor.
• Fixed a bug where the options menu would sometimes not open while in-game.

[b]We thank you, from our hearts, for playing and helping in the development of the game[/b], without you, nothing would have been possible. As you see there were a few changes to the game so if you find anything, please report then on our Discord. [b]Happy cleaning and Happy Halloween![/b] 🎃🤍

notes.title: Update Early Access V1.1.3 - 12.10.2024

Hi everyone! [b]Update V1.1.3 is Live![/b]

We're excited to introduce some fantastic new features and content in this update. Here's what’s new:

The long-awaited [b]Laboratory Map is here[/b]! This medium-large sized map is designed for experienced players and requires a minimum level 5 to access. Good luck!

[b]• Interior & Exterior Sounds:[/b] Every map now features distinct ambient background sounds for both indoor and outdoor areas.
[b]• New Ambient Sounds: [/b]Thunder, crows, rats, knocks, and many more have been added to all maps, creating a more immersive atmosphere.

notes.title: Update Early Access V1.1.2 - 04.10.2024

notes.title: Major Update V1.1
notes.notes:
Major Update Alert: [b]Welcome to V1.1[/b]!

Hello, everyone! We're thrilled to announce our first major update for the game. Here's what's new:

[b]Inventory and Equipment System:[/b]
• We've introduced a cart located outside the house where you can pick up and drop equipment using your [b]interact key[/b] and [b]"G"[/b].
• Equipment types include:
- Broom: for bones, trash, paper
- Mop: for water spills
- Rag: for windows, leaks, and blood
• Future updates will allow for equipment upgrades to speed up your cleaning tasks.

[b]AI Ghosts Behavior Update:[/b]
• Ghosts have gotten smarter and more sinister. They lurk in the shadows, adjusting their speed to the environment and waiting for your slip-up. Watch out for Linda—she's particularly aggressive and always ready to strike.

[b]Major Lobby Changes:[/b]
• Enjoy a fully reworked lobby where you can roam, pick up items, and even toss them at teammates!
• Tune into 6 non-copyrighted bangers on the lobby radio with your friends.
• Shop and Customization areas are now separate for a smoother experience—find gear on the PC and customize your look by the mirror.
• An Info Board is now available in the lobby, detailing each ghost's strengths and weaknesses.

[b]What to Expect Next?[/b]
Our upcoming update will be substantial, including:
• A new map (Laboratory)
• A new ghost
• Expanded item selection in the Shop
• Controller support
• Additional achievements
• A challenging new [b]"Nightmare"[/b] difficulty level for those who found Hard too easy!

[b]Feedback and Support:[/b]
Thank you for your support and active participation. If you encounter any issues with this update, please don't hesitate to reach out on our Discord server listed on the Steam Store Page . We aim to address problems swiftly.

[b]Happy cleaning, and enjoy the new challenges![/b] <3

notes.title: Update Early Access V1.0.6 - 28.06.2024
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone! [b]Update V1.0.6[/b] is here!

We're thrilled to introduce a host of new features and fixes to enhance your haunting experience. Check out what's new:

[b]NEW FEATURES:[/b]
• Difficulty Settings: Choose from Easy, Medium, or Hard modes, each with varying challenges and rewards:
Easy: 120 seconds until ghost spawns, normal tasks, 3 lights allowed, slower ghosts (100% rewards).
Medium: 90 seconds until ghost spawns, 20% more tasks, 2 lights allowed, normal speed ghosts (125% rewards).
Hard: 60 seconds until ghost spawns, 50% more tasks, 1 light allowed, faster ghosts (150% rewards).
• Increased Stamina: Players now have improved stamina for better endurance.
• Larger Light Switches: Switches on all maps have been enlarged for easier interaction.

notes.title: Update Early Access V1.0.3 - 11.06.2024
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We're back with another update featuring several fixes and changes. Here’s a rundown of the patches and updates:

Added:
• Character customization is now saved via Steam Cloud.
• Various optimizations for lower-end PCs.

Changes:
• Ravenwood Manor is now available at level 1.

• Increased the chase speed of The Demon and Split-face.

• Players can now return to the lobby even if the host is dead.
• Fixed issue where the screen would get stuck on a jumpscare after death.
